name: us-capital-gains
description: Work out a US resident individual's 2026 federal tax on capital gains. Covers short-term against long-term holding periods, the 0%, 15% and 20% rates with the 2026 maximum zero rate and 15 percent rate amounts from Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.03, the 25% unrecaptured section 1250 group and the 28% collectibles group, the 3.8% net investment income tax under 26 U.S.C. 1411 with its fixed USD 250,000, 200,000 and 125,000 thresholds, the USD 3,000 (USD 1,500 separate) loss limit and the carryover worksheet, wash sales under section 1091, Form 8949 and Schedule D, the home sale exclusion and installment sales, with a 2025 return section and a sell-now-or-wait decision case. Trigger on "US capital gains tax", "long-term capital gains rate", "Schedule D", "Form 8949", "LTCG 0% bracket", "NIIT", "net investment income tax", "wash sale", "capital loss carryover", "sell shares tax US", "should I sell now or wait". Federal only. For nonresidents see us-nonresident-cgt; for QSBS see us-section-1
